text:
mike_sales: Heads-up — FinBank (enterprise POC) just handed us a hard requirement: HSM-backed customer-managed keys (BYOK) + 30-day rotation policy. They want a POC next month. Can SE/infra confirm what we actually support on Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private? Also need rough delta on pricing and a checklist for the security questionnaire.

Tina_se: Short answer: Private supports an on-prem HSM or cloud HSM + KMS proxy. Dedicated can integrate with customer KMS in some cases but typically requires network peering/VPC access. Hosted (public API) currently supports envelope encryption with customer-supplied keys (CMEK) via partner KMS for specific regions — full HSM attestation (FIPS/HSM module) is only available in Private.

Sarah_security: @mike_sales +1. Also need to confirm key rotation flow. Do they want us to rotate keys on their schedule (30d) or accept rotated keys pushed by their KMS? That determines whether we need re-encryption of cached KV prefixes and how we manage tokenization.

Mike_sales: They said rotation should be automated and tracked; they expect Redwood to accept rotated key material without downtime. They also asked about hardware attestation report for HSM.

Jordan_prod: Technical notes: if they expect zero-downtime rotation we need support for key versioning + live key rollover in the runtime. In Private we can mount a KMS agent that provides multiple active key versions and the runtime can consult key-id per-request. On Dedicated/Hosted we'd need a compatible KMS API and a cached key store with fallback. Cache invalidation for KV/prefix cache is the tricky bit.

Tina_se: For the POC I suggest this checklist: 
- confirm HSM model + attestation method (Azure Key Vault HSM / AWS CloudHSM / on-prem net HSM)
- network requirements (peering, firewall rules, ports)
- KMS API creds and rotation webhook or polling interval
- test data set and sample prompt flow (latency sensitive path)
- success criteria (no >1% error, <50ms added tail latency, seamless rotation)

Maria_salesops: Pricing/contract notes: HSM integration is an enterprise add-on. For Private: one-time integration + monthly infra delta (licenses + HSM infra if we host). For Dedicated: likely a monthly premium for secure KMS tunnel + ops support. Hosted: we may refuse HSM attestation guarantees unless they move to Private. I'll draft numbers after SE confirms scope.

Sarah_security: Security questionnaire items to prepare: 
- KMS/HSM provisioning diagram + attestation docs
- Key lifecycle: creation, usage, rotation, destruction
- Who has access to key material (SRE, apps) and access controls
- Audit logs: retention, integrity, access
- Backup/DR for key material
- Crypto algorithms and key lengths (RSA/EC/AES-256-GCM)

Mike_sales: Can we get a minimal config snippet for the POC (what the customer needs to provide)? I'll send to their infra lead.

Jordan_prod: Example (high-level) config they can provide: 
```
kms_integration: 
  provider: "azure_key_vault_hsm" 
  key_id: "https://{vault}.vault.azure.net/keys/{key-name}/{version}" 
  auth_type: "service_principal" 
  rotation_webhook: "https://customer-webhook.example.com/key-rotated" 
  allowed_key_versions: ["v1","v2"]
```
Keep it short for their infra team.

Tina_se: POC timeline (est): 3 weeks 
Week 0: collect artifacts (network, key attestation, creds)
Week 1: integrate KMS agent + connectivity tests
Week 2: run workload, exercise rotation, measure latency + failover

Sec-qa-bot: Reminder: attach CIS/KMS checklist template: https://internal.redwood/example-kms-checklist (internal link)

Maria_salesops: I'll prepare a 1-pager quote: base POC fee, integration engineering days (estimate 5 days), monthly add-on for HSM support. Need SE input on the 5d estimate.

Tina_se: 5 days seems reasonable assuming no custom HSM drivers. If they want FIPS attestation retrieval and bespoke attestation automation add +2 days.

Mike_sales: Enterprise asks for SLA language about key availability during rotation. Who owns the SLA?

Sarah_security: Legal needs to approve any SLA that mentions key availability. Operationally, for Private we can offer SLA. For Dedicated/Hosted we can offer best-effort with clear fallbacks. I'll loop in legal.

Mike_sales: Great. Action items: @tina_se confirm technical scope w/ Jordan by EOD tomorrow; @maria_salesops draft quote w/ price bands; @sarah_security start filling security questionnaire and request attestation docs from customer. I'll sync with FinBank infra on Friday.

Tina_se: On it. I'll post integration checklist + sample scripts in #eng-ops after the EOD sync. :thumbsup:

Deploy-bot: Deployment note: created ticket INFRA-8423 for KMS agent work (assigned to jordan_prod).

Mike_sales: Thanks everyone — will update FinBank after the EOD call. :rocket:
